issues.failure_explanation: Step 1 claims that (F1) yields finite-dimensional nested $V_{n_2}\subset\mathrm{Lip}(\mathcal{X})$ with dense union. (F1) only posits density of Lip(𝒳) in $(\mathcal{F},\|\cdot\|_{\mathcal{F}})$; existence of a countable nested finite-dimensional dense family is equivalent to separability of $\mathcal{F}$ in that norm, which no axiom supplies. A Banach function space can satisfy (F1) verbatim while being non-separable (e.g. $\mathcal{F}=\mathrm{Lip}(\mathcal{X})$ under $\|f\|=\|f\|_\infty+\mathrm{Lip}(f)$, which contains a copy of the nonseparable $L^\infty$ via $g\mapsto(x\mapsto\int_0^x g)$), in which case the dictionary of eq:dense-dictionary does not exist and the tower producing the table is never constructed.

diagnostic_evidence.quote:
For every $m\in\N$ there exists $N\in\N$ such that for all $n\ge N$,
\[
\omega\bigl(R(F,c_n,\,2^{-m})\bigr)=0.
\]
$F$ is nonsingular with respect to $\omega$, i.e.\ $F_{\#}\omega\ll \omega$.

issues.failure_explanation: All conditions defining $B$ are $\omega$-a.e. statements about Borel codes; none forces $F$ to be nonsingular, yet $A_{z_0}$ is defined only for nonsingular $F$ (only then is $K_F$ an operator on $L^\infty$-classes, prop:boundednessLoo). Concrete phantom: on $\X=2^\omega$ with Bernoulli $\omega$, the continuous map collapsing the clopen cylinder $U_1=\{x:x_1=0\}$ onto $x_\infty$ and fixing its complement is singular ($\omega(F^{-1}\{x_\infty\})=1/2$, $\omega(\{x_\infty\})=0$). For $\varphi=\mathbf 1_{U_1}$ a.e. one has $\varphi\circ F=z_0\varphi$ $\omega$-a.e. (value at the $\omega$-null point $x_\infty$ chosen as $z_0$), so with all $c_n$ coding $\varphi$, conditions (i)-(ii) hold and $(F,\mathbf c,\mathbf c,\dots)\in B$, while $F\notin A_{z_0}$ (there $\K_F$ is not even defined on classes). Hence the claimed equality $\mathrm{proj}(B)=A_{z_0}$ is false, and the analyticity of $A_{z_0}$ is not established by this proof.

failure_location.quote: Finally, we check that the projection of $B$ onto the first coordinate is exactly $A_{z_0}$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Weaken lem:Az0-analytic to the hardness direction and adjust thm:route-IF-to-Az0 and thm:SCI_A_infty_Linfty_decision to use only $\Sigma^1_1$-hardness/non-Borelness (which is all their arguments consume); or rebuild the coding so witnesses are elements of the weak*-compact unit ball of $L^\infty(\omega)$ with conditions tied to the transfer operator, which is contained but nontrivial.
issues.overall_effect: The $\Sigma^1_1$-completeness claims (Step 1/Step 5 of thm:route-IF-to-Az0 and Step 1 of thm:SCI_A_infty_Linfty_decision, and the 'analytic-completeness' prose) are unsupported; only the hardness (non-Borelness) direction survives a repair.

On $\{x_\infty\}$ the map is the identity, hence $\sigma_{\mathrm{ap}}=\{1\}$.

issues.failure_explanation: The measure is the $(1/2,1/2)$-Bernoulli product measure, so the singleton block $\{x_\infty\}$ has $\omega$-measure $0$; lem:Linfty-block-sap is stated and proved only for blocks with $0<\omega(\mathcal X_j)<\infty$. The application violates the hypothesis, and the intermediate claim that the $\{x_\infty\}$-block 'contributes $\{1\}$' is false (on a null space $L^\infty$ is trivial, so that block contributes no approximate point spectrum at all). The stated inclusions remain true because $1\in\mathbb U_{2^{k_m}}$ for every $m$, but the derivation as written is invalid.

diagnostic_evidence.quote:
choose $u_m(S)$ to be the $\prec$-least extension $v$ such that
\[
\Sigma(v)\ \subseteq\ S\cap 2^m.
\]
The right-hand side is a finite subset of $\mathbb T$. Since $z_0$ is not a root of unity, $z_0$ is not in this finite set, hence $z_0\notin\sigma_{\mathrm{ap}}(\K_{F_S})$.

issues.failure_explanation: Greedy star-priority need not maximize stars over all admissible patterns. Counterexample: $S=\{\sigma\in2^{<\omega}:\sigma_1=0\}\cup\{1^n:n\ge0\}$. Then $S\in\mathcal V$: it contains the Silver tree $S_{A,x}$ for coinfinite $A=\{1\}$, $x(1)=0$. But the greedy gives $u_1=*$ (since $\Sigma(*)=\{0,1\}\subseteq S\cap2^1$) and, because $10\notin S$, forces $u_m=*\,1^{m-1}$ for all $m\ge2$; hence $k_m(S)=1$ for all $m$, bounded. By the paper's own lem:sap-FS-formula and lem:reverse_r3D1_SilverKoopman (bounded star-counts force $\sigma_{\mathrm{ap}}\subseteq\{-1,1\}$), $z_0\notin\sigma_{\mathrm{ap}}(\K_{F_S})$ for any non-torsion $z_0$. So the boxed equivalence $S\in\mathcal V\iff z_0\in\sigma_{\mathrm{ap}}(\K_{\Psi(S)})$ is false: lem:forward_SilverKoopman's Step 1 ($k_m(S)\ge|m\setminus A|$) is invalid, and the naive max-star repair breaks the reverse implication (unbounded level-wise star maxima can be attained only on leaves, with every branch finitely many stars).

failure_location.quote: the pattern $u_m(S)$ has at least as many $\ast$-coordinates as any admissible witness pattern.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must replace the star-priority greedy witness (or the dynamics built on it) by a Borel construction for which both implications $S\in\mathcal V \Leftrightarrow z_0\in\sigma_{\mathrm{ap}}(\K_{\Psi(S)})$ are re-proved — the level-wise max-star variant breaks the nested-limit reverse direction, where unbounded level-wise star maxima need not come from a single branch — and re-verify lem:sap-FS-formula/lem:spectrum_FS for the new map.
issues.overall_effect: The dynamical back end of both advertised lower bounds collapses: the equivalence driving thm:route-IF-to-Az0 ($\Sigma^1_1$-hardness/completeness of $A_{z_0}$, $\mathrm{SCI}_A=\infty$) and thm:SCI_G_infty_mclasses / cor:SCI_G_infty_alpha ($\mathrm{SCI}_G=\infty$ on $L^\infty$) fails, and with it the abstract's and introduction's advertised $L^\infty$ obstructions.
issues.title: Star-priority greedy witness does not dominate Silver patterns: the Silver-tree $\Leftrightarrow$ Koopman equivalence is false
issues.why_classification: The primary equivalence is false as stated, no comparable version is supported by the source, and every advertised $L^\infty$ lower bound (both type $A$ and type $G$) depends on it; any resolution needs a genuinely new witness/dynamics construction, so the issue is serious.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: For $\omega\in\Omega$ we have $f(\omega)\in B(y,r)$ iff there exists $m$ such that $f(\omega)\in B(y,r)^{(m)}$ and then eventually $f_n(\omega)\in B(y,r)^{(m)}$.

issues.failure_explanation: The claimed identity is false. Take $\Omega=\mathbb R$, $f_n\equiv f\equiv 1.1$, $B(y,r)=(-1,1)$: then $f\notin B(y,r)$ but $d(f,B(y,r))=0.1<2^{-3}$, so $f\in B(y,r)^{(3)}$ and $f_n\in B(y,r)^{(3)}$ eventually; the right-hand side is all of $\Omega$ while the left side is empty. Membership in the open ball cannot be captured by eventual membership in outer neighbourhoods of the ball; the proof establishes Borelness of a different (larger) set and does not prove the lemma as written.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the open-ball argument by the standard closed-set argument, e.g. $f^{-1}(\overline{B(y,r)})=\bigcap_m\bigcup_N\bigcap_{n\ge N}f_n^{-1}(\{z: d(z,\overline{B(y,r)})<2^{-m}\})$ and a covering of opens by closed balls; a short local edit leaving the statement and all downstream uses intact.
issues.overall_effect: Only the lemma's own proof is defective; the lemma is a standard true fact, and its uses (thm:borel_tower_implies_borel_target, hence the Borel-barrier appendix and the Borelness step in the type-$G$ lower-bound argument) remain valid after the routine repair.
issues.title: Pointwise-limit lemma: the displayed set identity for $f^{-1}(B(y,r))$ is false
issues.why_classification: A single routine repair (standard measurability-of-limits argument) preserves the lemma's statement and every dependent claim; no nontrivial new argument is needed.
